transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

I keep hearing people talking about me—through the conference room walls, or from my phone even when it’s off. It sounds like board members or staff saying I’m ruining the company. It’s so clear that I sometimes answer them before I realize nobody else heard anything.
About how long ago did you first start hearing these voices?
About three months now. That’s when I first started hearing them through the walls or from my phone.
Over these past three months, have you been feeling persistently down, depressed, or hopeless?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really thought of it as being depressed or hopeless.
Have you been using any recreational drugs, cannabis, or medications not prescribed to you?
I’m not really sure what you mean by that. Are you asking about things besides my regular prescriptions?
Yes, have you used alcohol, cannabis, or any street drugs?
I’m not sure what counts as street drugs. I haven’t really noticed using anything like that.
What medications are you currently prescribed?
I’m not sure of the names right now. I take my regular prescriptions, but I don’t have the list with me.
What medical conditions or physical health problems have you been diagnosed with?
I don’t know of any medical conditions I’ve been diagnosed with. I mean, nothing physical that I can think of right now.
Have you had periods where you felt unusually energetic and needed much less sleep than usual?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed a time when I needed a lot less sleep and felt unusually energetic.
Besides hearing these voices, do you believe people are actively conspiring or working together to harm your career or sabotage you?
I’m not sure. I haven’t noticed people working together to harm my career or sabotage me.
Do the voices comment on what you are doing as you go about your day?

Yes. I’ll be going about my day and hear board members or staff talking about me, saying I’m ruining the company. Sometimes it seems like it’s coming through the conference room walls, or from my phone even when it’s off. It’s so clear that I’ve answered them before I realize no one else heard it.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient reports prominent auditory hallucinations consisting of voices discussing or commenting on him (board members and staff stating he is ruining the company) originating through walls and from a turned-off phone. These symptoms have persisted continuously for approximately three months, satisfying the ICD-10 duration criterion of at least one month for schizophrenia, specifically paranoid schizophrenia (F20.0). Affective disorders, substance use, and general medical conditions were explored and are non-contributory.

confirmed_symptoms: Auditory hallucinations of board members and staff talking about the patient
Voices commenting on the patient's actions and performance ('ruining the company')
Perception of voices coming from unusual sources (conference room walls, powered-off phone)
